items.description: Xabi Alonso called the matter "closed" after Wesley Fofana appeared to joke about Chelsea's Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool during an unauthorised interview.

items.headline: Omar Marmoush hails Luca Williams-Barnett as 'unbelievable' after full Spurs debut
items.description: Omar Marmoush has hailed Luca Williams-Barnett as "unbelievable" and believes the teen sensation has a "very promising future ahead of him."

items.headline: FA panel details 'obvious error' in Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool
items.description: Referee Sam Barrott made an "obvious error" in sending off Manchester United defender Leny Yoro against Liverpool, an independent regulatory commission unanimously concluded.

items.headline: Cesc Fàbregas plays down Barcelona links, pledges immediate future to Como
items.description: Cesc Fabregas has pledged his immediate future to Como amid speculation that he could one day succeed Hansi Flick at Barcelona.

items.headline: Liverpool are all smiles as Florian Wirtz, Alexander Isak start to click
items.description: Another match, another fine set of displays from Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak. Is the huge investment in Liverpool's forward line beginning to pay off?

items.headline: Joshua Zirkzee backs Senne Lammens: 'We didn't draw because of him'
items.description: Joshua Zirkzee has said the Manchester United dressing room will rally around Senne Lammens after the goalkeeper's error against Sporting CP denied Mauricio Pochettino a first win as head coach.

items.headline: Soccer's main character this week: Jude Bellingham is in a new stratosphere

items.headline: Viktor Gyökeres: Arsenal not wasting energy on Man City's possible sanctions
items.description: Viktor Gyökeres said Arsenal cannot afford to waste any energy on Manchester City's possible sanctions -- as he vowed to deliver back-to-back Premier League titles for the Gunners.

items.headline: Champions League talking points: Was this a good result for Man United?

items.headline: Man United's costly errors overshadow early progress under Mauricio Pochettino
items.description: Manchester United showed signs of progress under Mauricio Pochettino, but familiar mistakes cost them a Champions League win against Sporting CP.

items.headline: Luis Enrique praises Roma after draw halts PSG's winning streak
items.description: Paris Saint-Germain coach Luis Enrique said Roma was his team's "toughest match of this season" after a hard-fought 2-2 Champions League draw on Wednesday.

items.headline: VAR review: Why Man United should've gotten winner vs. Sporting
items.description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

items.headline: Burley predicts how Pochettino will motivate Manchester United players

items.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Barcelona eye USMNT's Mathis Albert
